FC 27 Player Database & Config Manager

Inspect, export, or import EA SPORTS FC 27 player datasets and configuration settings in real-time.

Live Scrape / Sync from EasySBC.io

Pulls live ratings, prices and attributes directly from EasySBC's own player API (found via their site's network requests) and syncs them into the database below. The full EasySBC database has 1000+ pages (~20k players) sorted by meta rating, so pick how many pages to pull — each page is about 20 players. Pages fetch concurrently (in batches), so pulling more pages doesn't mean waiting proportionally longer.

Market Flips

Finds players on Futbin's market currently priced well under their real value — buy low, wait for the price to settle back up, sell for a profit. Uses a quick browser-console script instead of an in-app fetch, since Futbin blocks automated requests from other sites.

Pulled from a public, unauthenticated page — no Futbin login involved. Prices move fast and a real sale is never guaranteed at the average shown, so treat every number here as a snapshot to verify on Futbin before actually buying, not a promise.

1. Open the Futbin market page, then open your browser's console (F12 or Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+J) and paste this script in:

Want a different page range? Edit the START_PAGE and END_PAGE numbers near the top of the copied script before pasting it in — copy it fresh below any time you want to reset them.

Open the Futbin market page

2. It scrapes every page automatically and copies the result to your clipboard when it's done. Then just paste it here:

(Also works if you paste a single page's raw HTML instead — right-click → "View Page Source" — but the script above covers every page in one go, which is almost always less work.)
